trigger: The browser closed after submission while an HTTP response was being written.
previous_behavior: The response write exception was classified as internal_error, followed by an attempted HTTP 500 write to the disconnected socket.
fix_scope: Catch BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError and ConnectionAbortedError only around response header/body writes, then set close_connection=true. Do not cancel or mutate backend jobs. Preserve unrelated I/O failures and backend connection failures.

validation.method: targeted HTTP handler tests plus related capacity diagnostics and model-input protocol tests
